[[Onata's Shards]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Silent Ancient Onata]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Raisu Palace]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (vs. [[Hex Spell|Hexed]] foes)
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30
